# @three-ws/tty-3d

> The terminal 3D renderer core: GLB in, skinned and animated ANSI frames out. A software rasterizer with real glTF skeletal animation, no GPU, no browser and no display server, plus the three-tty CLI.

@three-ws/tty-3d is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/tty-3d`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/tty-3d/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/tty-3d/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/tty-3d/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/tty-3d/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
